name: Berbinzana (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the arms of Berbinzana (a golden image of Saint Mary beneath a canopy on blue).
history: The arms of Berbinzana are azure, an image of Saint Mary or beneath a canopy of the same; they were granted by the Diputación Foral de Navarra when the town agreed to make a new flag with its own arms.

features.role: Berbinzana arms — image of Saint Mary beneath a canopy on blue
